prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Changes:
0: [finish, new_screen] Desktop companion quick controls new screen: Add a new screen following home intro that outlines essential desktop pet interactions and control shortcuts. (why: Support messages show confusion about how to control or interact with pets after setup, and finish step conversion drops to 64.8%.)
1: [sign_in, redesign] Sign in layout account recovery focus redesign: Redesign the sign-in screen using a list layout focused on account restoration and pet inventory synchronization. (why: 8 support tickets cited pets missing or reset after signing back in, and sign-in exhibits high mean completion times.)
2: [home, new_flow] Desktop setup status preview new flow: Insert a desktop environment setup status checklist screen during the waiting sequence. (why: Waiting and home phases take substantial time (mean 2336s) and 3 users reported pets failing to appear on desktop.)
3: [adoption, redesign] Pick friend split layout feature showcase redesign: Redesign the pet selection step with a split layout to showcase companion traits alongside choices. (why: Adoption stage experiences a high mean duration of 1017s and drop-off to 68.5%.)
4: [choose_path, copy] Clear path selection intent copy update: Update headline and body on the path choice screen to provide direct contrast between preset adoption and photo creation. (why: Path selection mean duration is 514s, suggesting hesitation over option differences.)
5: [finish, layout] Home intro checklist layout finish step: Switch home intro layout to a checklist style highlighting setup completion milestones. (why: Finish conversion drops to 64.8% with long median and mean completion times.)
6: [home, wait_info] Companion rendering tips waiting screen info: Display practical advice on waiting screen regarding desktop pet placement while rendering completes. (why: Home waiting median is 201s (mean 2336s), making active guidance during generation crucial.)
7: [adoption, hint] Custom photo upload formatting hint: Add photo quality and framing guidance hints on the upload photos screen. (why: 3 support emails reported custom pet generation failures or distorted companion appearances.)
8: [sign_in, notification] Account pet sync confirmation notification: Enable ready notification flag on sign-in screen to confirm account sync status. (why: Multiple users reported missing pets after re-authenticating, creating anxiety during sign in.)
